cardOverview.overviewText: A Private card positioned as an ultra-premium invite-only product, offering bespoke concierge, milestone rewards, luxury experiences, and travel privileges.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: Buy One and Get One Movie ticket free with Yes Private Credit Card. Cardmembers can avail a maximum of 4 complimentary tickets in a month (no cap on the movie ticket value)
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: Events
benefitRows.offer: Get 50% off on Event tickets including Experiences, Events, Plays and Sports with Yes Private Credit Card (“Event Tickets”). Cardmembers can avail discount of up to INR 1000 every calendar month (Offer 1 and Offer 2 are collectively referred as “Offer”) .Both offers can be availed in a month.
